description: A waveshaping oscillator with two controls that bend its wave, for finding sounds by ear rather than by formula

params.text: Sets the pitch, -4 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 16Hz to 4186Hz
Scales the voltage at the FM jack, 0 to 300 per cent
While on, the FM jack is added to the frequency in hertz rather than to the pitch in octaves, which gives through-zero frequency modulation
Attenuates the voltage at the P1 jack before it is added to the P1 knob, 0 to 1
Attenuates the voltage at the P2 jack before it is added to the P2 knob, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Sets the pitch by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
Modulates the frequency through the FM knob; with Lin off it is added to the pitch in octaves, and with Lin on it is added to the frequency itself, which lets it pass through zero
Modulates the first shaping control, a tenth per volt scaled by the P1 CV knob
Modulates the second shaping control, one per volt scaled by the P2 CV knob

notes: there is no anti-aliasing here, so the harder settings of the two shaping controls alias at high pitches

inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
inputs.3:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 5V.
